title: Programmer Art Megapack
description: Programmer art for multiple mods, including Malum, Elemental Creepers, Bosses of Mass Destruction, Immersive Armors, Fishing Crates, Life Crystals, & yyzs backpack
body:
This pack includes custom textures for many mods, designed primarily to fit the classic programmer art style. It is highly unfinished, and as such, texture submissions are welcome in the linked Discord server.

### Supported mods
- Malum
- Elemental Creepers
- Bosses of Mass Destruction
- Fishing Crates
- Immersive Armors
- Life Crystals
- yyzsbackpack
